profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at HubSpot
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience in backend development and data engineering, currently building core infrastructure at HubSpot that powers how millions of customers experience new product features.

At HubSpot, I work on the Product Rollouts team, where I design and scale systems that govern controlled feature releases (percentage-based and selective rollouts), real-time customer feedback loops for beta features, and intelligent recommendation engines that personalize the discovery of Product Updates based on in-app behavior. My work directly accelerates product adoption, shapes customer engagement, and supports data-driven decision-making.

In the past, I’ve engineered RESTful APIs using Django and Flask, built scalable microservices with Python, Java, and Kafka, and deployed applications across AWS and Azure environments using Docker and Kubernetes. I’ve also explored serverless architectures, event-driven systems, and chatbot development using the Azure Bot SDK.

Today, I’m especially passionate about building high-performance distributed systems, leveraging AI and summarization techniques for scale, and working at the intersection of product growth, developer experience, and platform architecture.

Tech highlights: Java, Python, Kafka, MySQL, S3, Flask, Django, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GraphQL, AI/ML tooling (TensorFlow, scikit-learn)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
📬 Feedback System – Scalable Beta Feedback Collection
● To improve the beta-to-live journey for features at HubSpot, I built a feedback system allowing customers to seamlessly share thoughts on beta features in real-time. This ensured that product teams could iterate on actionable insights before full rollout.

● Handling feedback for hundreds of live betas — at scale — required a robust backend built on Java, Kafka, and distributed rate limiting techniques. This system now powers the feedback experience on HubSpot’s Product Updates page, enabling thousands of customers to shape the features they’ll eventually use.
positions.insights: Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP), Java and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
📣 Weekly Product Updates Roundup – Admin Engagement at Scale
● To keep portal admins informed of key HubSpot changes, I led the development of a weekly roundup email system highlighting the most impactful betas and releases.

● The system integrates asynchronously with multiple teams’ pipelines to collect and send curated summaries. I proposed and helped implement backend infra changes to support real-time capabilities. Additionally, I built an AI-based summarization tool to clean and structure unformatted HTML, which resolved long-standing issues in both the email and UI experience.

● After launch, the feature saw immediate success:
💌 57% open rate, 10.7% click rate (well above benchmarks)
🙌 Positive feedback around ease, clarity, and value — making it a key communication channel moving forward.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
🎯 Product Updates Recommendation
● This project aimed to intelligently recommend relevant Product Updates to users based on their in-app behavior — improving discovery and engagement. The architecture involved multi-threaded, cache-efficient systems that tapped into usage data across millions of portals.

● The project demanded extensive cross-team collaboration and was met with excellent adoption during its Beta phase. Its strong Slack and LinkedIn feedback, along with performance metrics, led to greenlighting multiple enhancements for 2025. It now forms a foundation for future machine learning-driven personalization within the HubSpot ecosystem.
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Infrastructure and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
ROLE:

Developed a scalable application using modern web technologies and microservice architecture to enhance offer creation, delivery, and management processes. Employed technical optimizations to ensure high performance.

● Optimized the database schema with caching and indexes to improve query performance for efficient handling of data and enhanced user responsiveness.

● Designed and implemented a data pipeline using cloud-based technology, eliminating manual data processing and reducing processing time significantly.

● Developed a scalable REST API gateway using Flask, Docker, and Kubernetes to handle incoming API requests with high performance and scalability.

● Created a machine learning solution using unsupervised clustering algorithms to address a critical client need, resulting in a significant reduction in data duplication. The solution was deployed and maintained efficiently using Python, Docker, and Kubernetes.

● Collaborated with the development team to build the backend server using Java-SpringBoot and cloud services for application scaling. Ensured seamless integration between frontend and backend components.

In summary, my role in the project involved utilizing modern web technologies, microservice architecture, and technical optimizations to develop a scalable application that improved offer creation, delivery, and management processes. I also contributed to the development of a data pipeline, REST API gateway, and a machine learning solution, addressing critical client requirements efficiently.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: AMS Demand and Supply

Human resource allocation to a project is a complex task that involves a multitude of moving parts and steps that must be completed for final allocations. To simplify this process, our team designed a web application for internal company purposes. My role in this project was to eliminate the clutter that these processes can generate on the front end through numerous fields. To achieve this, I built a chatbot that guides the user through predefined steps, significantly improving the user experience. This approach not only reduces the time required to complete the task, but it also minimizes the possibility of mistakes being made when filling out entries, resulting in an overall reduction in errors.

ROLE:

● Build the chatbot utilizing the Azure Bot SDK in Python.
● Define the bot's conversation flow and response logic using dialog management.
● Manage the bot's state for a consistent user experience.
● Deployment and testing through Azure Bot Service.
● Deploy chatbot's endpoint to frontend so that the entire service can be used to create automated dialogues for resource allocation process.
● Test and debug the chatbot through the built-in test functionality and integration with Azure DevOps in Azure Bot Service.
● Create a service in Python to create transcripts of chatbot conversations for resource allocation process that can then be used to verify process accuracy.
● Developed REST APIs using Django REST framework for chatbot specific data.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Programming Languages and +11 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: ADA Pathways GIS application

DXC built CommonPaths, a GIS app for disabled residents to navigate streets and sidewalks to paratransit pickup zones for MV Transportation. The goal was to create a pedestrian pathway app that complies with ADA standards and provides accessible maps for people with disabilities (e.g. wheelchair access, hearing impairment) as a modern GIS app.

CommonPaths integrates OpenStreetMap, ADA compliance routing, GIS modernization, and a multi-tenant platform for pathway review and public data contribution. It's an open source project - source code on GitHub. MV Transportation won an award for using CommonPaths to improve disabled residents' lives and reduce costs for King County, Seattle, and transit agencies.

ROLE:

Developed a scalable GIS service, to help disabled residents navigate to para-transit zones, resulting in a 15% decrease in operational costs. Technical tasks completed:

● Implemented a distributed, fault-tolerant routing service backend using Object Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and CI/CD pipeline in Python and Java for 99% uptime, reducing downtime costs.

● Devised REST APIs and a web application with Python, Django, CSS, Bootstrap, and AWS technologies (Elastic Beanstalk, CodeDeploy) to automate server deployment and cloud resource allocation. The implementation of these technologies shortened the tenant on-boarding time by 50%, streamlining the process and improving the user experience.

● Improved the GIS routing service by using AWS Lambda for auto and on-demand updates. This optimization led to a significant increase (90%) in client productivity, as the service was able to provide real-time updates and respond quickly to changing conditions.

● Conceptualized a computer vision/AI (POC) to detect objects in real-time, securing the project for DXC and demonstrating the potential to use cutting-edge technology to solve complex problems for clients.

positions.title: Junior Engineer
positions.description:
->I worked here as a Junior engineer and my jobs included data acquisition of IOT devices. While at Kahuna I was given the task of making an ultrasound simulator, a device that simulates the fetal activity inside a human womb. The entire part of data acquisition, data manipulation was done by me.
->The final outcome of this project was a prototype of the simulator that gave various realtime pictures of fetal activity depending on the orientation of device.

honors.title: METRO's 2021 Innovative Solutions Award Winners
honors.description:
The project(ADA Pathways/CommonPaths) that we delivered, won our client MV Transportation and King County, Seattle - 2021 Innovative Solutions Award, which was featured in the November issue of APTA’s "TRANS"form & Expo in Orlando, Fla.

The Innovative Solutions Awards honors bus operations and their supplier partners who have implemented initiatives that helped them save money, run more efficiently, streamline operations, increase safety, improve customer satisfaction, increase ridership, and more.

honors.title: Gold medal - Stood 1st in Bachelor's Degree
honors.description: I was awarded the Gold medal in my Bachelors degree for standing first in the entire state in the field of electronics and Communications.
honors.issuer: Issued by Gujarat Technological University · Dec 2016

projects.title: Customer Segments for wholesale distributor
projects.description: In this project I have applied unsupervised learning techniques on product spending data collected for customers of a wholesale distributor in Lisbon, Portugal to identify customer segments hidden in the data.

projects.title: Finding_donors_for_charity
projects.description:
In this project, I applied supervised learning techniques and an analytical mind on data collected
for the U.S. census to help a charity organization identify people most likely to donate to their cause.
